title: Fase 04 — Firebase Hosting deploy + GitHub Actions (cron de rebuild)
description: Deploy a Firebase Hosting con CI/CD vía GitHub Actions, incluyendo un cron de rebuild que regenera el snapshot de Firestore y reconstruye el SSG (para reflejar contenido nuevo manteniendo zero-JS para lectores anónimos). Cost containment: free tiers + budget alert $5/mes. Depende de la persistencia (A.7) y la optimización de assets (Fase 03). Cierra el Milestone 1 — Sitio publicable. Migrado desde GSD (.planning/ROADMAP fase 04).
acceptance_criteria: Deploy a Firebase Hosting funcionando para el sitio SSG
GitHub Actions: build + deploy en push a la rama por defecto
Cron de rebuild que corre snapshot-firestore + build SSG en schedule acotado
Budget alert GCP a $5/mes configurado (cost containment free tier)
Sitio en producción verificado: lectores anónimos cargan zero-JS, SEO/OG correctos

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
SITE IS LIVE: https://ecuahuecas.web.app (deployed manually via firebase --account rmatovelle84 --project ecuahuecas; 75 files). Verified: home 200, /resenas/<slug> 200 via cleanUrls, og:image=Sanity transform + og:type=article baked, favicon set + manifest present. main pushed to origin (cb70df8). Config/CI commit 608a6e9 reviewed: PASS, no HIGH/MEDIUM (no secret leakage; firebase.json SSG-correct; workflows valid).

Criteria status:
- (1) Deploy a Firebase Hosting funcionando — DONE (live).
- (5) Sitio en producción verificado (zero-JS estático + OG/SEO) — DONE.
- (2) GitHub Actions deploy en push — workflow .github/workflows/deploy.yml committed+pushed; ACTIVATES once the user adds repo secrets (SANITY_READ_TOKEN, FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ECUAHUECAS) + the 8 public VITE_* vars per DEPLOY.md.
- (3) Cron de rebuild — .github/workflows/rebuild.yml (daily 11:00 UTC + manual dispatch); same secret dependency. This is what auto-refreshes the build-time snapshot so newly published reseñas appear without a manual rebuild.
- (4) Budget alert $5/mo — MANUAL (GCP console / gcloud), user-owned.

Pending = user-owned manual ops (add GitHub secrets to activate CI/cron; set the budget alert). Holding TASK-015 in_review until the user confirms those (orchestrator will verify CI once secrets land), per the user's chosen 'deploy manual ya, CI después' path.
